scope: Exactly G1 epoch75 and G3 epoch174 selected-checkpoint validation replays; no training/test/final-checkpoint inference. Ensemble postprocessing is separate.

independent_checks.alignment: All 6686 validation indices/IDs/FP64 printed f labels and all three component masks match all three pinned eta arrays exactly.
independent_checks.numerics: FP32 model, TF32 disabled, primary FP64 trace and multiplication, historical FP32-trace crosscheck; each R2 must reproduce prior aggregate within 1e-6.
independent_checks.execution: Exact reviewed hashes required; exclusive STARTED receipt and pre-existing prediction guards; shared GPU4 lock, idle health and UUID before, unchanged ECC after.
independent_checks.data_scope: Model inputs and metrics indexed only by fixed validation indices. Eager Data storage includes full arrays; no test-row inference or metric consumption.
independent_checks.selection: Immutable best.pt selected by minimum legacy joint validation objective, not raw-f selection; exact checkpoint epochs and hashes checked against terminal/history.

conditions: GPU4 must pass fresh health/idle/exclusive-lock gate at execution.
Any partial execution failure requires root review; do not remove STARTED to rerun.
All prediction NPZ files remain server-only.
No architecture causality or promotion from these exploratory validation comparisons.
